critiques.note: Set the hair and beard base to #362926 and shifted the highlight (#5e4134) and shadow (#221a1b) to match, so the shading still reads.

critiques.text: Make his shoulders wider, his hands look goofy
critiques.note: Widened the chest to 24px with bigger shoulder caps set further out (about 32px across) and redrew the hands as rounded, shaded fists the width of the wrist.

critiques.text: The side walk looks super strange, give him some bend in his arms and knees when he walks.
critiques.note: Redrew the side walk with bent knees (heel strike, toe push-off, and a passing leg lifted with the knee forward), elbows bent and swinging opposite the legs, and the far arm showing behind the body.

critiques.text: his walk up and down look strange, change them to be more similar to his side walk which has a lot more detail.
critiques.note: Rebuilt the front and back walks like the side walk: the planted leg takes the weight while the trailing heel lifts, the passing leg rises with a bent, creased knee, and the elbows bend and swing opposite the legs (mirrored for the back view).
Fixed the back-swing hand being clipped at the edge of its layer, so the fist is drawn whole, and moved it onto whole pixels as a full 5px fist with lighter shading.

critiques.text: His arms are way to small rn, make them the size of the side walk and walk down
critiques.note: Replaced the thin idle arms (front, back and side) with the same thick, hanging arms the walks use, so idle and walk match.

critiques.text: his hand should be infront of his body when it swings
critiques.note: In the walk away from the camera the arms are now drawn behind the torso, so the forward-swinging hand passes in front of his body (hidden by his back) instead of over it.

critiques.text: Can you make him relatively the same size as titus, but a little bit shorter. Right now the dimensions look really weird specifically the neck
critiques.note: Matched Mason's build more closely to Titus, kept him three pixels shorter, and closed the neck gap in every direction.

critiques.text: Hey he is short and fat, base him off of how Titus was built, but keep the core aspects of how Mason is supposed to be different
critiques.note: Rebuilt Mason on Titus proportions with longer legs and a slimmer torso, retaining the cowboy hat, sunglasses, tactical gear, and Russian flag patch.

critiques.text: Ok so that is a little better., the torso is still too fat, and the head is too low. It looks like his head is being smashed into his body and he doesn't have a neck.
critiques.note: Narrowed the torso and shoulders, raised the head three pixels, and added a visible neck in all views and idle frames.

critiques.text: could you make his legs a little skinnier so they aren't so blocky. I want him to actually look fast
critiques.note: Slimmed the trouser legs and boots in every idle and walking view while preserving the bent-knee stride and planted feet.

critiques.text: Can you give him absolutely chiseled abs
critiques.note: Opened the tactical vest to show deeply shaded, chiseled abs with matching muscle definition in the side view.

critiques.text: the abs needs to be under the shirt, and he still needs to have pecs
critiques.note: Covered the torso with a fitted black shirt and shaded broad pecs and a narrower six-pack through the fabric.
